My dear [Mrs Elgie](/person/475)
This is only to tell you that I am thinking about you and [Blanche](/person/1480) and all.[^1] I would come to see you, but I think you had better not see a fresh person, and besides [Annie Moberly ](/person/1024)comes to me tomorrow May God bear you all through it

Ever yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: Blanche Webber (b. 1859/60) a child of Mrs Elgie’s first marriage to Captain Webber.
